description.short_caption: Radiograph of the left hip showing joint space narrowing and bony changes.
description.detailed_description: This is a plain radiograph of the left hip. The image demonstrates narrowing of the joint space, particularly at the femoral head and acetabulum. There are also subtle bony irregularities and possible sclerosis, suggesting degenerative or infectious changes. No obvious fractures or dislocations are visible.

description.short_caption: MRI of the left hip showing joint effusion and soft tissue changes.
description.detailed_description: This is a sagittal MRI image of the left hip. The image demonstrates a joint effusion with increased fluid signal within the hip joint. There is evidence of soft tissue swelling around the joint, and possible irregularity of the femoral head contour. The surrounding musculature and soft tissues appear altered, suggesting inflammation or infection.
visible_findings: joint effusion in the left hip
soft tissue swelling around the joint
irregularity of the femoral head contour
altered signal in surrounding soft tissues

description.short_caption: GMS stain showing fungal elements in tissue biopsy.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a tissue biopsy stained with Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) stain. Numerous round to oval darkly stained fungal elements are visible against a pale background, consistent with fungal organisms. The staining highlights the fungal cell walls, making them appear black. The surrounding tissue matrix is lightly stained, providing contrast to the fungal elements.
visible_findings: darkly stained round to oval fungal elements
GMS stain highlighting fungal cell walls

description.short_caption: Histopathology of lesion showing intracellular organisms on H&E stain.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained section of tissue. Numerous intracellular organisms are visible within macrophages, indicated by arrows. The organisms appear as small, round to oval structures with a clear halo, consistent with yeast forms. The surrounding tissue shows an inflammatory infiltrate with a mix of mononuclear cells.

description.short_caption: GMS stain showing fungal elements at higher magnification.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gomori methenamine silver (GMS) stain of a biopsy specimen at higher magnification. Multiple round, darkly stained fungal elements are visible, consistent with yeast forms. The background tissue is lightly stained, with some cellular structures visible. The fungal elements are prominent and appear to vary slightly in size.
